init.title: Messaging (WhatsApp and Telegram)
init.description:
Control the inventory, send receipt photos and get expiry alerts over WhatsApp, through a WAHA (WhatsApp HTTP API) server such as the WAHA add-on.

In WAHA, set the webhook URL to:
{webhook}
with the "message" event. If you set an HMAC key in WAHA, enter the same key below.

Leave the key fields blank to keep the currently stored values.

Telegram (optional) works through Home Assistant's Telegram bot integration: set that up first (with these chats allowed), then enable Telegram here and list the chat ids that may use the inventory. Other chats of the same bot are left alone.

data.waha_webhook_hmac_key: Webhook HMAC key (optional, must match WAHA)
data.whatsapp_allowed_senders: Allowed numbers - may send commands and receive alerts (comma-separated, country code first, no +)
data.whatsapp_people: Who each number is, for reminders - comma-separated <number>=<person entity>, e.g. 15551234567=person.alex
data.telegram_enabled: Enable Telegram (through the Telegram bot integration)
data.telegram_chats: Telegram chats that may use the inventory and receive alerts - comma-separated chat ids, optionally with the person for reminders, e.g. 123456789=person.alex, -1001234567890
data.telegram_bot_entry: Telegram bot to use (only needed when more than one is set up)
data.reminder_radius: Reminder radius for shared locations (how close counts as "there")
data.whatsapp_debug: Verbose logging (logs each incoming message, the agent reply and the send result to the Home Assistant log)
data.receipts_enabled: Read receipt photos sent over WhatsApp or Telegram
data.ai_task_entity: AI Task entity used to read receipts (required when receipt scanning is on)

error.ai_task_required: Receipt scanning needs an AI Task entity — pick one above, or turn receipt scanning off. If the list is empty, add an AI Task entry to your AI integration (Settings → Devices & Services → Google Generative AI → Add entry) and reopen this form.
error.invalid_url: Enter the full WAHA address, starting with http:// or https://
error.invalid_telegram_chats: Use chat ids (numbers, negative for groups), each optionally followed by =person.<id>, separated by commas
error.telegram_chats_required: List at least one Telegram chat id, or turn Telegram off
